about: Shapes of the local API for requests between the owner's computers (routes /tasks*). Same rules as api_shapes.json; checked against the real backend in tests/test_tasks_units.py and tests/test_tasks_machines.py.

Tasks.route: GET /tasks; also the answer of POST /tasks/switch, POST /tasks/mode, POST /tasks/{id}/approve and POST /tasks/{id}/answer

TasksSwitch.note: on: whether this computer takes requests from the owner's other computers. Off by default. network: what carries this computer's link (tailscale | lan | loopback | null); on lan requests and answers are signed but readable, and the page says so

TasksMachine.note: the owner's other computers, by name. takes_requests: what THIS computer last heard about that computer's own switch (true: on, false: off, null: not known: never heard, or not heard lately). The sharing computer hears it first hand; a linked computer hears it in the sharing computer's signed answers and only while in sync

TaskLogRow.note: dir: out (asked from here; peer = the computer asked) | in (asked of this computer; peer = who asked) | relay (passed along by the sharing computer; peer asked peer_to; no text). state: queued | running | waiting_approval | done | failed | refused | timeout | cancelled. label: ready to show

TaskResult.note: label: 'done on Surface - 12 s', 'waiting for approval on Surface', 'not sent: requests are switched off on Surface', ... hint: only while waiting for approval; approval: only while a step waits there AND that computer lets this one answer it

TaskWaiting.note: a step of a request that waits for the owner of THIS computer; answered with POST /tasks/{id}/approve {"choice": "once"|"deny"}. command and description are what Hermes shows for the step; they never leave this computer

TasksMode.note: what happens on THIS computer when a step of a request needs approval. value: here (default; the step waits for the owner on this computer) | linked (the computer that asked is shown the step and may answer it too) | safe (such a step is refused at once). Chosen on this computer only, with POST /tasks/mode {"mode"} or `hermes twin requests mode`; no other computer can set it. warning: the one sentence to show before `linked` is turned on

TaskAsking.note: a step that waits on ANOTHER computer (peer) for a request asked from this one, which that computer lets this one answer (its mode is `linked`); answered with POST /tasks/{id}/answer {"choice": "once"|"deny", "q"}. command and description are the step as that computer shows it, password-like text hidden

TaskAnswered.note: a step of this request was answered from the computer that asked (mode `linked`): what was answered and the name of the computer it was answered on

TaskResultApproval.note: the step as the asked computer shows it, for the owner to read. Its mark is not in a result: the page (Tasks.asking), `hermes twin requests` and /twin approve show what answers it
